name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A complete labeled number field: a scrub area (with custom cursor icon) over an 'Amount' label for drag-to-adjust, a Decrement/Input/Increment stepper group, and an uncontrolled default value of 100.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — defaultValue={100} on Root, no component state; React.useId only generates the id linking the bare <label> to the field
nonTrivialInteractions: Horizontal drag scrubbing on the ScrubArea (including its nested label) adjusts the value, with a custom CursorGrowIcon rendered as the ScrubAreaCursor child
Decrement/Increment buttons step the value down/up and render icon children
Accessible name via a bare <label htmlFor={id}> element (the docs page's recommended label path), with the id from React.useId passed to Root
Disabled-state styling is driven by data-disabled attribute selectors in CSS rather than props
Styling is applied entirely via className on every part (Tailwind variant shares a stepperClasses constant for Decrement/Increment)
